name: India AI Governance Guidelines
summary: Guidelines unveiled by MeitY on 5 November 2025, per a government broadcaster (All India Radio) report. The content of the document has not been verified from a primary source: the PIB page and PDF could not be read. Confidence low. Status 'in_force' is used loosely for a published guidance document.

timeline.note: Guidelines unveiled by MeitY with the Principal Scientific Adviser and MeitY Secretary present (All India Radio report; not the issuing body).
